usage.initial_usage_source: statistical-plan.json used_before_campaign, or documented default of 5 seconds
usage.note: Only final unique-job charges enter known usage. Pending or missing usage is unknown, not zero. The remaining upper bound is not permission to submit.

coverage.scope: All unordered hardware coupling edges, one prescribed orientation per new edge; not all orientations, pulse schedules, or circuit designs.
coverage.note: Coverage counts unordered data pairs with completed exploratory XX/YY/ZZ records. Repeated controls do not add coverage; only the prescribed orientations were scanned.

exploratory_ranking_note: Exploratory only, subject to selection bias. Baseline repeats sharing an unordered data pair are one grouping, represented by the earliest stage and spec order, never its best repeat. Counts are not pooled. Circuit variants are grouped by variant/layout/optimization level. Confirmation observations are excluded.
drift_note: Repeated controls are displayed separately without pooling or treating them as independent new candidates. Different orientations, ancilla choices, or optimization levels are labeled recipe changes and cannot alone establish temporal drift.

report.interpretation: This replication passes the prespecified shot-noise criterion.
report.scope: One replication of a previously frozen candidate. Aggregate the prespecified independent replications before declaring success. This does not establish the globally optimal method.
report.uncertainty_note: Finite independent-shot uncertainty, conditional on accepted counts. Wilson intervals have approximate coverage; Bonferroni adjustment and endpoint propagation are conservative. Plug-in SE can be zero at sample boundaries. Excludes drift, measurement bias, and other systematic errors. Postselected fidelity describes retained trials, not all attempted trials. The three bases must measure the same prepared state. Estimates are not clipped.

report.multiplicity_note: At most three prespecified candidate attempts; Bonferroni alpha across attempts. Every replication must pass. All failed attempts must remain in the report; the caller enforces the attempt limit.
report.scope: Best supported tested candidate, not proof of a globally optimal method.

bootstrap.method: Independent multinomial resampling within variant x basis x fault-branch, then combine shared draws.
bootstrap.interval: two-sided 99% percentile; approximate, may degenerate at observed boundaries
bootstrap.pairing: Same-job matched protocol; distinct circuits are not per-shot paired observations.
bootstrap.limits: Assumes exchangeability within branch; excludes time drift, systematic readout bias and calibration uncertainty.

report.interpretation: A pass supports conditional filtering of this declared X-error channel, not ambient-noise improvement, arbitrary-noise protection, or increased unconditional correct-output throughput.

controlled_noise.note: Controlled-noise stages never enter ambient rankings or edge coverage. Fully rejected postselected branches retain null fidelity/CI values. Their QPU charges remain in the same 600-second campaign budget.

uncertainty_note: Candidate intervals combine three Bonferroni-adjusted Wilson bounds with approximate coverage. They describe shot uncertainty, not calibration drift or systematic error. Values are not clipped; retention is reported for postselection.
